statement: A Pakistani humanitarian organisation uses unrestricted non-Zakat relief funds to distribute emergency assistance overseas according to verified need, without differentiating recipients by ethnicity or religion. Which principle of Islamic global engagement is best reflected?

option_b: Reciprocal benefit should determine the scope of humanitarian assistance
option_c: Human welfare may be pursued through impartial need-based assistance
option_d: Cultural affinity should determine the distribution of external relief

statement: Hajj takes place from _____ of Zil-Hajj.

statement: The basic unit of society in Islamic civilization is _____ :

option_d: surrendering legal order whenever communities disagree
description: Tolerance is peaceful coexistence with firmness on principles.

statement: The classical institution of Hisbah was most closely associated with:
option_a: hereditary transfer of administrative offices between families
option_b: supervision of military recruitment and territorial defence alone
option_c: oversight of fair dealing and certain public-interest obligations
option_d: collection of every category of state revenue from citizens

option_b: Weak moral formation accompanying material progress
option_c: Weak cultural continuity accompanying technical innovation
option_d: Weak civic participation accompanying demographic change
description: Material progress without moral tarbiyah leads to corruption.

statement: When a genuinely new issue requires an Islamic legal assessment, the soundest general procedure is to:
